summary:
Held 0 of today's 10 biggest UK/EU movers.

• 6 upside misses — BVI.PA +7%, IMB.L +5%, SAN.PA +5%, VOW3.DE +5%, STLAP.PA +5%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (ASM.AS -7%, CCC.L -7%, BGEO.L -6%, BESI.AS -6%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: ASM.AS (-7.24%) — no obvious news catalyst found — searches turned up no ASM-specific news for 2026-11-26, so likely a semicap/AI-chip sector de-rating or profit-taking after a strong run. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe: ASM.AS is a ~€30B Dutch mid/large-cap semiconductor-equipment name on Euronext Amsterdam, and no strategy includes it. With no news trigger, a news-reactive filter would also have had nothing to fire on.

top_movers.catalyst: No obvious news catalyst found for Bureau Veritas on 2026-11-26. Searches showed nothing dated today, so this is likely a sector or technical rebound, possibly helped by the ongoing portfolio rotation (the oil & petrochemicals testing divestment).
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe: BVI.PA is a mid/large-cap French testing and inspection (TIC) services stock, and no strategy's universe includes it. A +6.6% move with no news also gives a news-reactive bot nothing to trigger on.
top_movers.suggestion: Add a low-priority 'unscreened movers' watchlist to the momentum universe: Euronext/CAC 40 and SBF 120 names with a daily move ≥ +5% on volume ≥ 1.5× the 20-day average. Run it in paper mode first to measure follow-through before allocating capital.

top_movers.catalyst: No confirmed catalyst: searches found no 2026-11-26 news for Imperial Brands (IMB.L). Likely a defensive/sector rotation or post-results drift, but that is unverified.
top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe: IMB.L is a UK FTSE 100 tobacco large-cap, low-beta, and rarely screens as a momentum or gap candidate. A +5.4% move on no news also gives a news-reactive bot no trigger.
top_movers.suggestion: Add a daily 'unexplained mover' scan that flags any FTSE 100/STOXX 600 name with a close-to-close move of at least +4% and volume of at least 1.5x its 20-day average, and log it for review. Don't add the name to a trading universe yet.

top_movers.miss_reason: Outside any active strategy's universe: Sanofi is a CAC 40 large-cap pharma, and no strategy's universe includes it. Even if included, the move was M&A-driven and extended (RSI ~81, 2nd-day follow-through), so overbought filters would likely have blocked it.
top_movers.suggestion: Add large-cap CAC 40/Euro Stoxx 50 health-care names to the momentum universe, with an M&A-gap carve-out that waives the RSI>70 cap when a ≥4% gap follows a 5%+ M&A headline and volume is ≥1.5× average.
